title: PoisonCTI: Single-Source Poisoning of LLM-Based CVE Severity Assessment
description: Code, data, and run logs for the PoisonCTI mechanism study: single-source RAG poisoning of LLM CVE severity assessment and a leave-one-out consistency defense across Llama 3 8B, Qwen2.5 7B, and Mistral 7B. Paper PDF available in the repository and as a linked Zenodo record.
